"""Contracts for REQ-003 document intake."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Literal
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024

FormatName = Literal["pdf", "docx", "xlsx", "pptx", "jpg", "png"]

_ALLOWED_MEDIA_TYPES_BY_EXTENSION: dict[str, set[str]] = {
    ".pdf": {"application/pdf"},
    ".docx": {
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    },
    ".xlsx": {
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    },
    ".pptx": {
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation",
    },
    ".jpg": {"image/jpeg", "image/jpg"},
    ".jpeg": {"image/jpeg", "image/jpg"},
    ".png": {"image/png"},
}

_NORMALIZED_FORMAT_BY_EXTENSION: dict[str, FormatName] = {
    ".pdf": "pdf",
    ".docx": "docx",
    ".xlsx": "xlsx",
    ".pptx": "pptx",
    ".jpg": "jpg",
    ".jpeg": "jpg",
    ".png": "png",
}


class UploadAckResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    document_id: UUID
    state: Literal["uploaded"]
    uploaded_at: datetime


class DocumentStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    document_id: UUID
    original_filename: str
    media_type: str
    format: FormatName
    size_bytes: int = Field(ge=0, le=MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES)
    state: str
    uploaded_by: str
    uploaded_at: datetime


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UploadCommand:
    filename: str
    media_type: str
    content: bytes
    actor_id: str
    correlation_id: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DocumentWriteRecord:
    document_id: UUID
    original_filename: str
    media_type: str
    format: FormatName
    size_bytes: int
    storage_uri: str
    state: str
    uploaded_by: str
    uploaded_at: datetime


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AuditWriteRecord:
    event_id: UUID
    document_id: UUID
    actor_id: str
    event_type: str
    before_value: dict[str, str] | None
    after_value: dict[str, str]
    reason: str | None
    created_at: datetime


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StoredUpload:
    document: DocumentWriteRecord
    audit: AuditWriteRecord


class IntakeClientError(Exception):
    """Client-visible validation error."""

    def __init__(self, status_code: int, detail: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(detail)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.detail = detail


class IntakeRuntimeError(Exception):
    """Runtime error surfaced to the route layer."""

    def __init__(self, detail: str, *, cleanup_attempted: bool = False) -> None:
        super().__init__(detail)
        self.detail = detail
        self.cleanup_attempted = cleanup_attempted


def sanitize_filename(filename: str) -> str:
    candidate = filename.replace("\x00", "")
    candidate = candidate.rsplit("/", maxsplit=1)[-1]
    candidate = candidate.rsplit("\\", maxsplit=1)[-1].strip()
    if not candidate:
        raise IntakeClientError(status_code=400, detail="filename_required")
    return candidate


def resolve_upload_format(filename: str, media_type: str | None) -> tuple[FormatName, str]:
    sanitized_name = sanitize_filename(filename)
    extension = sanitized_name.rsplit(".", maxsplit=1)
    suffix = f".{extension[-1].lower()}" if len(extension) == 2 else ""

    normalized_format = _NORMALIZED_FORMAT_BY_EXTENSION.get(suffix)
    if normalized_format is None:
        raise IntakeClientError(status_code=415, detail="unsupported_media_type")

    allowed_media_types = _ALLOWED_MEDIA_TYPES_BY_EXTENSION[suffix]
    normalized_media_type = (media_type or "").strip().lower()

    if normalized_media_type and normalized_media_type not in allowed_media_types:
        raise IntakeClientError(status_code=415, detail="unsupported_media_type")

    chosen_media_type = normalized_media_type or next(iter(sorted(allowed_media_types)))
    return normalized_format, chosen_media_type


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable, Protocol
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, Integer, JSON, String, Text, create_engine, delete, func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, Session, mapped_column, sessionmaker

from backend.documents.intake.contracts import AuditWriteRecord, DocumentStatusResponse, DocumentWriteRecord
from backend.shared.events.contracts import ProcessingRequestedEvent


class Base(DeclarativeBase):

class DocumentRow(Base):

    uploaded_at: Mapped[object] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False)
    validated_by: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)
    validated_at: Mapped[object | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)


class AuditEventRow(Base):
    __tablename__ = "audit_events"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True)
    document_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=True, index=True)
    actor_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)
    event_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    before_value: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=True)
    after_value: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=True)
    reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[object] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False)


class IntakeUnitOfWork(Protocol):
    """Upload transaction boundary."""

    def add_document(self, record: DocumentWriteRecord) -> None: ...
    def add_audit_event(self, record: AuditWriteRecord) -> None: ...
    def stage_processing_event(self, event: ProcessingRequestedEvent) -> None: ...
    def collect_staged_processing_events(self) -> list[ProcessingRequestedEvent]: ...
    def delete_document_bundle(self, document_id: UUID) -> None: ...
    def get_document(self, document_id: UUID) -> DocumentStatusResponse | None: ...
    def commit(self) -> None: ...
    def rollback(self) -> None: ...
    def close(self) -> None: ...


@dataclass
class SqlAlchemyIntakeUnitOfWork:
    session_factory: Callable[[], Session]
    _staged_processing_events: list[ProcessingRequestedEvent] = field(default_factory=list, init=False)
    _committed_processing_events: list[ProcessingRequestedEvent] = field(default_factory=list, init=False)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.session = self.session_factory()

    def add_document(self, record: DocumentWriteRecord) -> None:
        self.session.add(
            DocumentRow(
                id=str(record.document_id),
                original_filename=record.original_filename,
                media_type=record.media_type,
                format=record.format,
                size_bytes=record.size_bytes,
                storage_uri=record.storage_uri,
                state=record.state,
                uploaded_by=record.uploaded_by,
                uploaded_at=record.uploaded_at,
            )
        )

    def add_audit_event(self, record: AuditWriteRecord) -> None:
        self.session.add(
            AuditEventRow(
                id=str(record.event_id),
                document_id=str(record.document_id),
                actor_id=record.actor_id,
                event_type=record.event_type,
                before_value=record.before_value,
                after_value=record.after_value,
                reason=record.reason,
                created_at=record.created_at,
            )
        )

    def stage_processing_event(self, event: ProcessingRequestedEvent) -> None:
        self._staged_processing_events.append(event)

    def collect_staged_processing_events(self) -> list[ProcessingRequestedEvent]:
        events = list(self._committed_processing_events)
        self._committed_processing_events.clear()
        return events

    def delete_document_bundle(self, document_id: UUID) -> None:
        self.session.execute(
            delete(AuditEventRow).where(AuditEventRow.document_id == str(document_id))
        )
        self.session.execute(delete(DocumentRow).where(DocumentRow.id == str(document_id)))

    def get_document(self, document_id: UUID) -> DocumentStatusResponse | None:
        row = self.session.get(DocumentRow, str(document_id))
        if row is None:
            return None
        return DocumentStatusResponse(
            document_id=UUID(row.id),
            original_filename=row.original_filename,
            media_type=row.media_type,
            format=row.format,
            size_bytes=row.size_bytes,
            state=row.state,
            uploaded_by=row.uploaded_by,
            uploaded_at=row.uploaded_at,
        )

    def commit(self) -> None:
        self.session.commit()
        if self._staged_processing_events:
            self._committed_processing_events.extend(self._staged_processing_events)
            self._staged_processing_events.clear()

    def rollback(self) -> None:
        self.session.rollback()
        self._staged_processing_events.clear()
        self._committed_processing_events.clear()

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.session.close()


def _engine_kwargs(database_url: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    if database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
        return {"connect_args": {"check_same_thread": False}}
    return {}


def build_session_factory(database_url: str) -> Callable[[], Session]:
    engine = create_engine(database_url, future=True, pool_pre_ping=True, **_engine_kwargs(database_url))
    return sessionmaker(bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False, class_=Session)


def create_tables(database_url: str) -> None:
    engine = create_engine(database_url, future=True, pool_pre_ping=True, **_engine_kwargs(database_url))
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)


def count_audit_events(session: Session) -> int:
    return int(session.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(AuditEventRow)).scalar_one())

"""Runtime configuration for REQ-003 intake."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Callable, Literal

from backend.documents.intake.repository import SqlAlchemyIntakeUnitOfWork, build_session_factory
from backend.shared.events.contracts import ProcessingEventPublisherPort
from backend.shared.events.publishers import (
    HttpProcessingEventPublisher,
    SnsProcessingEventPublisher,
)
from backend.shared.storage.contracts import ObjectStoragePort
from backend.shared.storage.s3_adapter import S3ObjectStorageAdapter

RuntimeProfile = Literal["local", "aws", "onprem"]
EventAdapter = Literal["sns", "http"]


def _required_env(name: str) -> str:
    value = os.getenv(name)
    if value is None or value.strip() == "":
        raise ValueError(f"missing required environment variable: {name}")
    return value


def _bool_env(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    return raw.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IntakeSettings:
    runtime_profile: RuntimeProfile
    database_url: str
    s3_bucket: str
    s3_region: str
    s3_endpoint_url: str | None
    s3_access_key_id: str | None
    s3_secret_access_key: str | None
    s3_force_path_style: bool
    event_adapter: EventAdapter
    sns_topic_arn: str | None
    sns_endpoint_url: str | None
    onprem_event_ingress_url: str | None

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> "IntakeSettings":
        runtime_profile = os.getenv("INTAKE_RUNTIME_PROFILE", "local").strip().lower()
        if runtime_profile not in {"local", "aws", "onprem"}:
            raise ValueError("INTAKE_RUNTIME_PROFILE must be one of: local, aws, onprem")

        event_adapter = os.getenv(
            "INTAKE_EVENT_ADAPTER",
            "sns" if runtime_profile in {"local", "aws"} else "http",
        ).strip().lower()
        if event_adapter not in {"sns", "http"}:
            raise ValueError("INTAKE_EVENT_ADAPTER must be one of: sns, http")

        if runtime_profile in {"local", "aws"} and event_adapter != "sns":
            raise ValueError(
                "INTAKE_EVENT_ADAPTER must be sns for local and aws profiles in REQ-003"
            )
        if runtime_profile == "onprem" and event_adapter != "http":
            raise ValueError(
                "INTAKE_EVENT_ADAPTER must be http for onprem profile in REQ-003"
            )

        return cls(
            runtime_profile=runtime_profile,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            database_url=_required_env("INTAKE_DATABASE_URL"),
            s3_bucket=_required_env("INTAKE_S3_BUCKET"),
            s3_region=_required_env("INTAKE_S3_REGION"),
            s3_endpoint_url=os.getenv("INTAKE_S3_ENDPOINT_URL"),
            s3_access_key_id=os.getenv("INTAKE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
            s3_secret_access_key=os.getenv("INTAKE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
            s3_force_path_style=_bool_env("INTAKE_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE", runtime_profile == "local"),
            event_adapter=event_adapter,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            sns_topic_arn=os.getenv("INTAKE_SNS_TOPIC_ARN"),
            sns_endpoint_url=os.getenv("INTAKE_SNS_ENDPOINT_URL"),
            onprem_event_ingress_url=os.getenv("INTAKE_ONPREM_EVENT_INGRESS_URL"),
        )


def build_storage_adapter(settings: IntakeSettings) -> ObjectStoragePort:
    return S3ObjectStorageAdapter(
        bucket=settings.s3_bucket,
        region_name=settings.s3_region,
        endpoint_url=settings.s3_endpoint_url,
        access_key_id=settings.s3_access_key_id,
        secret_access_key=settings.s3_secret_access_key,
        force_path_style=settings.s3_force_path_style,
    )


def build_event_publisher(settings: IntakeSettings) -> ProcessingEventPublisherPort:
    if settings.event_adapter == "sns":
        if not settings.sns_topic_arn:
            raise ValueError("INTAKE_SNS_TOPIC_ARN is required when INTAKE_EVENT_ADAPTER=sns")
        return SnsProcessingEventPublisher(
            topic_arn=settings.sns_topic_arn,
            region_name=settings.s3_region,
            endpoint_url=settings.sns_endpoint_url,
            access_key_id=settings.s3_access_key_id,
            secret_access_key=settings.s3_secret_access_key,
        )
    if settings.event_adapter == "http":
        if not settings.onprem_event_ingress_url:
            raise ValueError(
                "INTAKE_ONPREM_EVENT_INGRESS_URL is required when INTAKE_EVENT_ADAPTER=http"
            )
        return HttpProcessingEventPublisher(settings.onprem_event_ingress_url)
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported event adapter: {settings.event_adapter}")


def build_uow_factory(settings: IntakeSettings) -> Callable[[], SqlAlchemyIntakeUnitOfWork]:
    session_factory = build_session_factory(settings.database_url)
    return lambda: SqlAlchemyIntakeUnitOfWork(session_factory=session_factory)

"""Service layer for REQ-003 intake."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Callable
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from backend.documents.intake.contracts import (
    AuditWriteRecord,
    DocumentStatusResponse,
    DocumentWriteRecord,
    IntakeClientError,
    IntakeRuntimeError,
    MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES,
    UploadAckResponse,
    UploadCommand,
    resolve_upload_format,
    sanitize_filename,
    utc_now,
)
from backend.documents.intake.repository import IntakeUnitOfWork
from backend.shared.events.contracts import (
    EventTransportError,
    ProcessingEventPublisherPort,
    ProcessingRequestedEvent,
)
from backend.shared.storage.contracts import ObjectStorageError, ObjectStoragePort

logger = logging.getLogger("backend.documents.intake")


@dataclass
class IntakeService:
    uow_factory: Callable[[], IntakeUnitOfWork]
    storage: ObjectStoragePort
    publisher: ProcessingEventPublisherPort
    now_provider: Callable[[], datetime] = utc_now

    def upload_document(self, actor: Any, command: UploadCommand) -> UploadAckResponse:
        _ = actor

        size_bytes = len(command.content)
        if size_bytes > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:
            raise IntakeClientError(status_code=413, detail="file_too_large")

        sanitized_filename = sanitize_filename(command.filename)
        upload_format, normalized_media_type = resolve_upload_format(
            sanitized_filename,
            command.media_type,
        )

        document_id = uuid4()
        uploaded_at = self.now_provider()
        storage_key = self._storage_key(document_id, sanitized_filename)
        uow = self.uow_factory()
        stored = False

        try:
            stored_object = self.storage.put_object(
                key=storage_key,
                data=command.content,
                content_type=normalized_media_type,
                metadata={
                    "document_id": str(document_id),
                    "uploaded_by": command.actor_id,
                    "format": upload_format,
                },
            )
            stored = True

            document = DocumentWriteRecord(
                document_id=document_id,
                original_filename=sanitized_filename,
                media_type=normalized_media_type,
                format=upload_format,
                size_bytes=size_bytes,
                storage_uri=stored_object.uri,
                state="uploaded",
                uploaded_by=command.actor_id,
                uploaded_at=uploaded_at,
            )
            audit = AuditWriteRecord(
                event_id=uuid4(),
                document_id=document_id,
                actor_id=command.actor_id,
                event_type="upload",
                before_value=None,
                after_value={
                    "document_id": str(document_id),
                    "state": "uploaded",
                    "storage_uri": stored_object.uri,
                    "original_filename": sanitized_filename,
                    "media_type": normalized_media_type,
                    "format": upload_format,
                    "size_bytes": str(size_bytes),
                },
                reason=None,
                created_at=uploaded_at,
            )
            event = ProcessingRequestedEvent(
                document_id=document_id,
                storage_uri=stored_object.uri,
                media_type=normalized_media_type,
                format=upload_format,
                size_bytes=size_bytes,
                actor_id=command.actor_id,
                uploaded_at=uploaded_at,
                correlation_id=command.correlation_id,
            )

            uow.add_document(document)
            uow.add_audit_event(audit)
            uow.stage_processing_event(event)
            uow.commit()
            committed_events = uow.collect_staged_processing_events()
        except IntakeClientError:
            uow.rollback()
            raise
        except ObjectStorageError as exc:
            uow.rollback()
            logger.warning(
                "document_upload_storage_failed",
                extra={
                    "event": "document_upload_storage_failed",
                    "actor_id": command.actor_id,
                    "correlation_id": command.correlation_id,
                },
            )
            raise IntakeRuntimeError("storage_write_failed") from exc
        except Exception as exc:
            uow.rollback()
            cleanup_attempted = False
            if stored:
                cleanup_attempted = self._safe_delete(storage_key)
            logger.exception(
                "document_upload_unexpected_failure",
                extra={
                    "event": "document_upload_unexpected_failure",
                    "actor_id": command.actor_id,
                    "correlation_id": command.correlation_id,
                    "cleanup_attempted": cleanup_attempted,
                },
            )
            raise IntakeRuntimeError(
                "document_upload_failed",
                cleanup_attempted=cleanup_attempted,
            ) from exc
        finally:
            uow.close()

        try:
            for committed_event in committed_events:
                self.publisher.publish_processing_requested(committed_event)
        except EventTransportError as exc:
            cleanup_attempted = self._compensate_failed_publish(document_id, storage_key)
            logger.warning(
                "document_upload_event_publish_failed",
                extra={
                    "event": "document_upload_event_publish_failed",
                    "document_id": str(document_id),

        self.published: list[ProcessingRequestedEvent] = []

    def publish_processing_requested(self, event: ProcessingRequestedEvent) -> None:
        self.attempts += 1
        if self.fail_publish:
            raise EventTransportError("publish_failed")
        self.published.append(event)

    service = IntakeService(
        uow_factory=lambda: SqlAlchemyIntakeUnitOfWork(session_factory=session_factory),
